fields.label: Account Name
fields.description: Also the name of its payment gateway, which apps pass to start a payment, e.g. KCB Nairobi Till.

fields.label: Till Number
fields.description: The KCB / Vooma till the money goes to: 1 to 7 digits. The payer sees it with the payment reference in the M-Pesa prompt.

fields.label: Complete Payments on KCB's Callback
fields.description: KCB cannot be asked whether a payment went through. On: a callback carrying the request ID only KCB was given, the exact amount, the phone prompted and an M-Pesa code completes the payment. Off: every KCB payment waits on the review list for someone to check the till statement.

fields.label: Payment Gateway
fields.description: Created when this account is saved, switched off. Switch it on there once Test Connection succeeds.

fields.label: Public Site Address
fields.description: The public https address of this site that the provider can reach, with no path, e.g. https://pay.redcross.or.ke. Blank: the site's own address. KCB takes a callback address of at most 50 characters, and ours is this address followed by /api/method/kcb, so keep the address short.

fields.label: Callback Address
fields.description: What KCB is given. Filled in when the account is saved.

fields.label: Production Token URL
fields.description: From KCB when the account goes live, e.g. https://…/token

fields.label: Production STK Push URL
fields.description: From KCB when the account goes live, e.g. https://…/mm/api/request/1.0.0/stkpush
